scope: Only live route, FK_DECISION, FK_TARGET, live composition excerpt and subsequently authorized compact FK_WORD_PRIORS; no prior gloss treated as anchor; source-name/context exposure is not blinding.

A.whole_rendering: A cloudy suspension is enclosed in a bowl. Agitate it downward; its dense fluid settles. Draw off the upper layer as fluid gradually, then agitate until uniform and clarify it through a narrow passage. Move a small amount outward from the enclosure; remove coarse matter, move the retained separated portion outward, and continue outward until the coarse-free outflow ceases. Turn it back, move it outward slowly and little at a time through the opening; initiate outward movement, strain, and move into a receiving cup, where the collected portion rests. Press the portion retained in the original enclosure and transfer some through a fine barrier. Recall that fluid and initiate outward percolation along the wall; return it downward and let it rest. Separate a released portion, separate and retain a part of that portion, and initiate its outward transfer. Percolate a small amount of the recalled fluid; recall that fine fluid, heat it, move it, and stop. Agitate the remaining amount evenly, seal the mouth, and retain reference to that same fluid.

B.whole_rendering: Congested moisture lies within a bodily cavity. It warms downward; its dense moisture collects below. The peripheral portion exudes as moisture gradually, then warms until steady and thins through a narrow passage. A small amount moves outward from the enclosure; obstruction releases, a retained separated portion moves outward, and the pressure-free outflow continues until it ceases. It turns back and moves outward slowly and little at a time through the opening; outward movement begins, constriction eases, and the moisture moves into a receiving bodily region, where the accumulated portion rests. The moisture retained in the original cavity is urged onward and a portion transfers through a fine passage. Recall it and initiate outward conduction along the wall; it returns downward and rests. Separate a released portion, separate and retain part of that portion, and initiate its outward transfer. Conduct a small amount of recalled moisture; recall that thin moisture, cool it, move it, and stop. Warm the remaining amount gently, open the mouth, and retain reference to that same moisture.

grammar_rules.name: Nominal introduction/derivation
grammar_rules.rule: Lexical InputMaterial introduces M; ContainerIntroduction introduces C containing M. DerivedMaterial descriptors introduce named subportions of a paid parent; no generic unknown entities.

grammar_rules.name: Typed sequential predication
grammar_rules.rule: Processes execute in written order. Each requires the last salient compatible written participant unless an explicit following object is required. Opening-process waits for following OpeningReference; no event-to-material cast.

grammar_rules.name: Postposed modifier
grammar_rules.rule: Modifier attaches to nearest preceding compatible event/reference; a quantity can qualify its moved portion. Fixed type domains, not occurrence-specific meanings.

grammar_rules.name: Spatial framing
grammar_rules.rule: A location before any event frames the next event. Otherwise a location qualifies nearest preceding motion/process. Enclosure references keep C; opening and wall are C parts; receiving location introduces V.

grammar_rules.name: ol
grammar_rules.rule: On MaterialClass: recall last explicitly tracked compatible material. On EventDefinition: explicitly fill its material patient with that reference. Separate ol scopes onto next complete term, identical semantics to attached ol.

grammar_rules.name: o
grammar_rules.rule: Prefix on Motion or selected Partition event: outward direction from current enclosure. An endpoint may remain unspecified; no implicit new destination object.

grammar_rules.name: q
grammar_rules.rule: Prefix on EventDefinition: initiate that event, preserving all arity and types. Not a lexicalized meaning for each occurrence.

grammar_rules.name: d
grammar_rules.rule: Prefix on MaterialClass: dense property of the described material.

grammar_rules.name: t
grammar_rules.rule: Prefix on Partition definition: address released branch as the new active material.

grammar_rules.name: k
grammar_rules.rule: Prefix on Partition definition: address retained branch as the new active material. t/k choice is a paid hypothesis, not established polarity.

grammar_rules.name: Prefix composition
grammar_rules.rule: Apply rightmost lexical core first, operators successively outward. Segmented bytes concatenate exactly; no aliases.

grammar_rules.name: Material assertions
grammar_rules.rule: MaterialClass/Description asserts type/property of tracked material and refreshes reference; a derived noun names its explicit parent-related portion. Terminal recalled nominal asserts retained availability, rather than a silently inserted final action.

defaults.rule: Most recent compatible typed patient; never a raw unknown.
Unary processing preserves individual identity unless explicit partition/portion descriptor creates a new named part.
A bare class describes active material rather than creating a fresh unrelated input.
Functional enclosure-content descriptors use original M in C, even after active focus shifts to a drawn portion.
After a receiving location V is written, subsequent unspecified outward transfer can keep V as destination; return reverses the latest C/V route. Earlier outward events retain unspecified endpoints.
Unspecified transfer quantity can be a proper portion; remaining-amount descriptor names the remaining portion of the most recently tracked material. Its numerical amount is unbound.

equivalence_assessment: Much of the movement/portion graph is shared and container-to-body renaming alone is equivalent. Thermal direction, aperture state, and material-versus-container predicate patient are different paid content assertions. Current data do not select them.
potential_discriminator: Freeze these whole values and the typed parent/route/default grammar, then seek an already admitted complete context where KEDY has a written hotter/colder resulting state or QOKEEY has a written traversability result. A passage needing opening after QOKEEY differs from closure after it. No such binding is claimed here; imagery and external comparison were not inspected.
prior_effect: DAIIN, OL, SHEDY, QOKEEDY, QOKEEY and OTEDY occur broadly: draft them as generic transfer/reference/material/process roles, avoiding rare object names. Singleton PDSHEODY/SHDOL/DCHEFOEY/SOEEEDY/ODEEDAIIN/DOLTSHDY/RORAIN and other rare forms are costly contextual whole assumptions. Frequency or section concentration does not validate their meanings, and conjectural o/d/t/k/ol rules are not proven component export.
gaps_and_debts: No lexical or grammatical meaning confirmed; 43 independent lexical bindings are expensive, not a compactness theorem.
The exact prefix analysis and t/k branch polarity are conjectures.
Derived upper/retained/remainder portions and C/F/O/V identities are fixed explicit whole meanings but not independently supported.
Six defaults pay salience, persistence, parent enclosure, route continuation and unspecified transferred quantities. Their broad portability is untested.
Terminated/returned motion, fluid subdivision, energy sources and agents are only the declared event-level account; numerical conservation and causal mechanisms are not fully written.
Terminal OL SHEDY is an explicit paid availability/class assertion; it is not a hidden final consumer event.
All modifiers and references have a declared attachment, but no independent exhaustive parser establishes uniqueness of these scopes.
The two renderings use paragraph-wide connective grammar; added English articles and punctuation are grammatical realization, not decoded signs.

coverage.claim_ceiling: Two connected exploratory content constructions; no translated words, source identification, independent confirmation, or selected rival.
